title: The Calendar Effects of the Idiosyncratic Volatility Puzzle: A Tale of Two Days?
authors: Jie Cao; Tarun Chordia; Xintong Zhan
eligible_reason: Asset-pricing paper on calendar effects in the idiosyncratic-volatility anomaly: portfolio sorts and Fama-MacBeth regressions; 'difference-in-difference' in the text refers to return differentials across IVOL portfolios and days. No treatment adoption design.
design_notes: SAS code for portfolio sorts and factor alphas using CRSP/Compustat/TAQ data from WRDS.
data_files_note: Only sas_code.txt and readme; data downloaded from WRDS (CRSP, Compustat) and Ken French library, not shipped.
